card.name: Small words before directions or conditions
card.fires_on: Short linking words in label directions: "as" after "between meals, or" before "prescribed/directed by a physician", and "if" after "Do not use". Also the P in "USP" after injection fluid names.

modes.label: The phrase "as directed"
modes.description: The word "as" in "or as prescribed/directed by a physician" at the end of a dosing instruction.
modes.example: One (1) capsule daily, between meals, or<< as>> prescribed by a physician.

modes.label: The phrase "Do not use if"
modes.description: The word "if" right after "Do not use" in warnings.

modes.description: The final P of "USP" following a diluent such as sodium chloride or dextrose injection.
